text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking along the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I thought all paths were closed to me.
Yet you reached out your hand with such gentle eyes...
You are the one who――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Trainer!!
Whoaa, what a coincidence~!
Cut!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Non! Non, Kita-kun!
You must not revert back to yourself while acting!
Come on, let's start over from the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hah...! U-Ughhh...!
The path of acting is truly harsh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... In other words, she sought my guidance
and set foot on the path to becoming a star of the silver screen...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, you're wrong!
I'm not in a movie, and I'm an extra, not a star in the first place!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Actually, a drama I like is recruiting extras right now.
I was thinking maybe I'd try applying once myself...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Howeeeever!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My sixth sense—no, my seventh radiance tells me:
You are not meant to remain a mere extra!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Natural-born star qualities,
combined with my tutelage, will surely
turn you into a prima donna!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, being an extra is totally fine, you know!?
I can only participate in filming for one day anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside TM Opera O's booming laughter,
it was surprising to learn that Kitasan Black had an interest in acting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her father has had a long, multifaceted career in show business.
If Kitasan Black had asked, he probably would have given her acting lessons, but...
choice_data_list: Why didn't you ask your father to coach you?
Why didn't you ask your father to coach you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's, um...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted it to be a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a drama I love, but actually my whole family loves it too. Whenever I'm back home, we always gather around to watch it together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So the next time I go home,
I think we'll sit side by side on the sofa watching again.
And if, at that time, I appear on the screen...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I thought Dad would be happy too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. So Christine volunteered for a supporting role without relying on him,
all just to see her father smile...
choice_data_list: She's a girl full of guts and kindness, after all.
And with these skills, a future star of the silver screen...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh... Understood.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, instead of a phantom,
why don't I become a jack-of-all-trades who can solve anything?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if her brilliance is that of a leading star,
if only for a fleeting moment, to play a supporting role...
No matter how difficult a wish that may be.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, well then, please continue directing my acting—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! First, run toward the setting sun!
Let the passion inside your chest burn bright!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Y-Yes!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, T.M. Opera O's acting guidance had its unique and baffling moments, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: G-Guts~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her natural honesty and earnestness,
Kitasan Black absorbed the training with everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, she happily reported to me
that she had watched the drama she appeared in as an extra
right alongside her father.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, no, look, the audition
I'm applying for this time is only for
an extra, you know...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, I can tell! This girl has the talent
to become a pillar of the theater world one day!
And she will co-star in my productions, too!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, allow me to impart some vital
skills to that end! Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!?
Hey, both of you~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Kitasan Black received acting lessons from T.M. Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How I was almost chosen to be the lead in a TV show
is another story entirely.
